notes:
Hold a chat to pin, mute, archive or delete it, several at once. The + button opens your contacts, a new group, a new contact and Message yourself.
Give contacts your own names (only you see them), choose who sees your status (all contacts, all except some, or only some), and tap a photo for that person's status or profile.
Video calls: filters and background blur, and the name and time fade so the picture stays clear.
One account per phone.
